content:
The book “Creating a Roadmap Towards Circularity in the Built Environment” has been published, which compiles the first works carried out under the Cost “Circular B” action, and includes two articles by Vanessa Tavares and Marco Pedroso.

In this open-access publication, you can read in chapter 17 the article “Barriers and Opportunities in the Transition to a Circular Construction Sector in Portugal”, and in chapter 23 the article “Circular Economy Supporting Policies and Regulations: The Portuguese Case”, which were written based on the work carried out by the two authors at BUILT CoLAB as part of the Circularity in Construction project and PACCO – Action Plan for Circularity in Construction.

You can read the full book here.

Remember that a COST action is an interdisciplinary research network that brings together researchers and innovators to investigate a topic of their choice for 4 years. COST actions are usually made up of researchers from academia, SMEs, public institutions and other relevant organizations or stakeholders.
